summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal and retail developments, including major IPOs and Reliance's expansion, amidst a backdrop of economic growth potential.

bullets.text: Trilegal, TT&A, and Chandhiok & Mahajan advised on HD Fire Protect's ₹712 crore IPO.
Reliance Consumer launched Joyland Dairy Drinks, expanding its FMCG portfolio.
The government extended the aluminium can certification deadline to April 2027, benefiting beverage manufacturers.
D2C brands in India target over 30% growth during the festive season despite a 20% rise in acquisition costs.
Billionaire Mukesh Ambani launched India's largest-ever IPO, marking a significant milestone in the market.
